column1: # Pinned downloads for setup-host (fetched with curl --proto =https, then
# checked against sha256 before use). Nothing here is piped into a shell.
# Tab-separated; columns: id kind url sha256 dest hosts arch tier human.
#   kind   script (downloaded to a scratch dir, then run), binary, archive, file
#   sha256 64 lowercase hex; "-" only for human=inspect rows
#   dest   "-" for scripts, otherwise a tokenized path (see tools.tsv)
#   arch   any, x86_64 or aarch64; (id, arch) is unique
#   human  "-", sudo (a person runs it), inspect (a person reads it first)
# Every digest below was computed from a fresh download on 2026-10-09 and,
# for GitHub release assets, matches the digest GitHub publishes for it.
id
# Homebrew/install main head 2026-10-07 (commit 8ab1549dfa1189fd4d818a2116592d8f0ee06d8c); 35651 bytes.
# Also installs Linuxbrew under /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew on wsl-ubuntu and lab-ubuntu.
homebrew
# nvm-sh/nvm v0.40.8, by the commit its tag peels to; 17883 bytes. The script would clone the
# mutable tag, so S4-nvm runs it with NVM_INSTALL_VERSION set to the commit in this url and
# then requires the checkout's HEAD to be that commit.
nvm
# mamba-org/micromamba-releases 2.9.0-0: a bare static executable, chmod 755; digests match upstream .sha256 files.
micromamba
micromamba
# openai/codex tag rust-v0.161.0 (peeled 979011409de0a60b52f179721948e65531d26144), the stable
# release this lab-ubuntu host has run since 2026-10-06 (its x86_64 bin/codex is byte-identical).
# The codex-package tarball is flat (no top-level dir): bin/codex, bin/codex-code-mode-host,
# codex-package.json, codex-path/rg and codex-resources/ (bwrap, zsh, plus voice on x86_64), so
# the Linux sandbox uses the bundled bwrap. Lay it out the way OpenAI's installer does: extract
# into a fresh temp dir under dest, read version and target from its codex-package.json, add the
# relative link codex -> bin/codex inside it, move it to dest/releases/<version>-<target>,
# ln -sfn dest/current to that release dir (absolute target), then ln -sfn
# dest/current/bin/codex to $HOME/.local/bin/codex. Never run OpenAI's install.sh and
# never write rc files.
codex
codex
# Anthropic's native installer is not version-pinnable: download, show digest and size, read, then run.
claude
# ryanoasis/nerd-fonts v3.5.1 CascadiaMono.tar.xz: flat archive of 36 CaskaydiaMonoNerdFont{,Mono,Propo}-*.ttf
# files plus LICENSE and README.md; extract into dest, then fc-cache -f.
nerd-font
# kovidgoyal/kitty v0.49.2: .txz whose top level is bin/ lib/ share/; extract into dest
# (tar -C dest -xJof), then link dest/bin/kitty and dest/bin/kitten into $HOME/.local/bin.
kitty
kitty
# catppuccin/bat main head 2025-06-29 (commit 6810349b28055dce54076712fc05fc68da4b8ec0); run bat cache --build after.
bat-theme
